'''Dimalium-6''' was a chemical substance mined and distilled by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was of special interest to [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] because of its psychoactive properties. Dimalium-6 enhanced the effects of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and had disruptive effects on both memory and mood.

Imperial Intelligence used dimalium-6 as a component of [[IX serum]], a powerful compound that allowed for [[brainwashing]] triggered by a keyword.
